bio: Indulge in an elegant Afternoon Tea at Peebles Hydra, a spa hotel with a welcoming atmosphere in the Scottish Boarders. This iconic landmark in the heart of Peebles is set upon the Venlaw Hill and has a rich and interesting history as part of the town.  Their traditional Afternoon Tea offering includes a selection of dainty finger sandwiches, golden scones with lashings of cream and jam and miniature sweets such as their mouth-watering macarons! Guest can also opt for a savoury Afternoon Tea which includes Scottish delicacy's of haggis tweed and Cullen skink tart.  Why not upgrade your Afternoon Tea to include a crisp glass of Champagne or 1881 Gin and Tonic made onsite in their own gin distillery!  Afternoon Tea is served in the Peebles Hydra Restaurant, a spacious room flooded with natural light, boasting beautiful original features and marvellous high ceilings.
